data.name: MeineDaten_Intro
data.value: These details were transmitted by BundID when you signed in to the Citizen Portal.

data.name: MeineDaten_NoBundId
data.value: You are signed in with an older account without BundID. Sign out and sign in again with BundID to see your details here.

data.name: MeineDaten_TrustLevel
data.value: Level of assurance of this sign-in

data.name: MeineDaten_StepUpHint
data.value: Some services, for example submitting a passport application, require the level “substantial”. The portal then asks you to sign in again automatically – you can also trigger this here yourself.

data.name: Level_0_Text
data.value: No BundID level of assurance is available for this sign-in.

data.name: Level_1_Text
data.value: Sign-in with user name and password. Sufficient for simple services such as booking an appointment.

data.name: Level_3_Text
data.value: Sign-in with a means of identification of medium security, such as the ELSTER certificate. Required e.g. for submitting a passport application.

data.name: Level_4_Text
data.value: Sign-in with the highest level of security, such as the online ID function (eID).

data.name: Method_Benutzername
data.value: User name and password of the BundID account.

data.name: Method_Elster
data.value: ELSTER certificate, as also used for tax returns.

data.name: Method_eID
data.value: Online ID function of the identity card or electronic residence permit.

data.name: Method_eIDAS
data.value: Electronic means of identification from another EU member state (eIDAS).

data.name: Method_Other
data.value: Other means of identification supported by BundID.

data.name: MeineDaten_PostfachText
data.value: The Citizen Portal sends confirmations for appointments and applications to your BundID mailbox. You sign in there with BundID as well.

data.name: MeineDaten_Stored
data.value: What the Citizen Portal stores permanently

data.name: MeineDaten_StoredIntro
data.value: Only what is needed to recognise you at your next sign-in and to send messages to your BundID mailbox is stored:

data.name: MeineDaten_PostkorbHandle
data.value: Postkorb handle (address of your BundID mailbox)

data.name: MeineDaten_SessionOnly
data.value: BundID provides your name, birth details, address and email address anew at every sign-in. The Citizen Portal keeps them only while you are signed in and discards them when you sign out. Details you submit yourself in an application are stored with that application.
